episodes.name: Did the Earth Move for You?
episodes.overview: Will's all-consuming romance with a new girlfriend shakes up the Banks' household, as does Mother Nature, trapping them together during an earthquake.

episodes.name: The Mother of All Battles
episodes.overview: Will and Carlton arrive as reinforcements when a bully challenges Ashley to a rumble, but there's real trouble when Philip and Vivian intervene.

episodes.name: Will Gets a Job
episodes.overview: Will tries to juggle school and a new job in order to earn money for the homecoming party, at the same time Ashley's classmate Tina becomes interested in Carlton. Will starts becoming paranoid when he constantly is getting confused with Carlton.

episodes.name: PSAT Pstory
episodes.overview: Will is a picture of confidence, while Carlton is a frazzled bundle of nerves preparing for college aptitude tests.

episodes.name: Granny Gets Busy
episodes.overview: Mortified over spying his mother kiss the handyman, Philip can't bear to think of her having a new man in her life.

episodes.name: Guess Who's Coming to Marry?
episodes.overview: Tensions spill over just before the wedding of Will's Aunt Janice when Will's mom meets Janice's intended - and forbids Will to attend the interracial wedding.

episodes.name: The Big Four-Oh
episodes.overview: Vivian's 40th birthday marks a crisis and a career change in which she plans to perfect her dance skills.

episodes.name: She Ain't Heavy
episodes.overview: Will hits it off with the full-figured Dee Dee, but her size keeps him from asking her to the dance.

episodes.name: Cased Up
episodes.overview: A pompous lawyer who's dating Hilary is no fan of Will's after he's sideswiped by Will's roadster.

episodes.name: Hi-Ho Silver
episodes.overview: Will and Carlton think a party guest stole the silverware.

episodes.name: The Butler Did It
episodes.overview: Bell Biv DeVoe shoots a video at the Bankses, courtesy of Carlton, who rents the house while his parents are away.

episodes.name: Something for Nothing
episodes.overview: After winning at the country club's Monte Carlo night fund-raiser, Will learns that he's expected to donate the money to charity.

episodes.name: Christmas Show
episodes.overview: On a family ski trip, the Banks find that they must come up with Christmas gifts from the heart after their belongings are stolen.

episodes.name: Hilary Gets a Life
episodes.overview: Hilary must work for a caterer after her credit cards are cancelled.

episodes.name: My Brother's Keeper
episodes.overview: On the basketball court, winning is everything to Will, as it is to an opponent from Malibu Prep, who can't afford to lose.

episodes.name: Geoffrey Cleans Up
episodes.overview: Geoffrey falls hard for a neighbor he believes is a housekeeper - but who turns out to be very wealthy.

episodes.name: Community Action
episodes.overview: When Hillary is ordered to do community service at a free clinic, the doctor in charge becomes the antidote for her marriage-mindedness.

episodes.name: Ill Will
episodes.overview: The family fears a steamy exposé when Geoffrey begins his memoirs, while Will fears the scalpel when he enters the hospital, kicking and screaming, for a tonsillectomy.

episodes.name: Eyes on the Prize
episodes.overview: Needing a game show partner, Will must choose between bickering friends.

episodes.name: Those Were the Days
episodes.overview: Philip and Vivian welcome a '60s radical, who arouses the FBI's interest and influences Will and Carlton to take action over the firing of a nonconformist teacher.

episodes.name: Vying for Attention
episodes.overview: Will dislikes his mother's new boyfriend.

episodes.name: The Aunt Who Came to Dinner
episodes.overview: Aunt Helen arrives unexpectedly, and upsets Will and Carlton's plans for a rendezvous with two French women.

episodes.name: Be My Baby Tonight
episodes.overview: Ashley cringes when the family oohs and aahs over her relationship with Kevin , but Will chokes when she asks him about sex - and her curiosity about reproduction sends Will to a pregnancy counseling center.

episodes.name: Strip-Tease for Two
episodes.overview: Will and Carlton lose their shirts investing on a tip - then take jobs as strippers to recoup their losses and get Vivian's bracelet out of hock.
